title: model
description: Cross-pipeline type reference: named types, their descriptions, and occurrence paths across all schemas. Occurrence keys use the de-versioned family-dir grammar (model_join.csv's): '<pipeline>/<family>', resolved against the family's latest version; values are instance JSON Pointers into a datum of that family. Curated under the disposal discipline of issue #19: candidates from the schema catalogues, dismissals in model_dismissed.txt, the pending queue reported by `yoga model` and check_model_curation.
